# Contributing to `aide`

Thank you for considering to contribute to AIDE. Please read and follow the notes below to prevent disappointment or wasted effort.

## Support

For any support questions use the [AIDE user mailing list](https://www.ipi.fi/mailman/listinfo/aide). Support questions opened as GitHub issues are closed unanswered.

---

## Bug Reports / Feature Requests

Please use the provided templates for [bug reports](https://github.com/aide/aide/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) and [feature requests](https://github.com/aide/aide/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

For security issues, do not file a public issue and follow the instructions in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

---

## Pull requests

Every pull request must reference a GitHub issue. Before writing any code, discuss the planned changes with the maintainers in a new or existing GitHub issue (exception: documentation fixes, smaller than 10 lines, or typo fixes).

This avoids wasted effort, if for example the proposed changes conflicts with planned work on the project roadmap.

Pull requests without a corresponding GitHub issue may be closed without further notice.

---

## Interim generative AI Usage Policy

This project is run by volunteers. They invest their spare time to maintain the codebase and build the community. Generally reviewing issues, feature requests, and code contributions is often time consuming, even more if they are full of generated AI content/slop.

The maintainers engage in open source to interact with humans and not to interact with generative AI (directly or indirectly through a human proxy). They can do that on their own, if they want to.

In addition, the legal status (such as copyright, licensing or authorship) of generative AI output is still unsettled in many jurisdictions.

Therefore:

- This project does not allow any code contributions that are, in part or in full, generated by or derived from generative AI (including large language models (LLMs)). In this context, code contributions include, but are not limited to, source code, documentation, pull requests descriptions and, commit messages.

- All contributions must be authored and submitted by a human who understands them and is prepared to answer questions about them.

- Contributors may use generative AI for research, analysis, educational aid, bug discovery, debugging, or drafting issue or comment submissions, if and only if the generative AI follows all instructions in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

- The maintainers may close any issue or pull request that looks AI generated and doesn't follow this policy without further comment.

The maintainers review this generative AI Usage policy regularly.

---

Thanks for contributing.
